user_clarification: Team has no access. Prefer an easier image-only source. See access_review.json for the OpenForensics option. This video protocol is not agreed.
question: Do saved GenImage-trained detectors transfer to localized face manipulation without adaptation?

dataset.access_status: Not established; team member must obtain author approval and accept terms.
dataset.alternative: Celeb-DF v2 official test list; requires a separate protocol version and access approval.
dataset.rationale: Matched source scenes, explicit manipulation method and compression, official source-video pairs, limited-download support.
dataset.download_status: Only public split metadata retrieved; no videos, frames, or model weights downloaded.
license_questions: Confirm every participating teammate has permitted access.
Confirm terms permit any proposed external multimodal image upload before calls.
Keep licensed media out of GitHub.

sampling.selection: Canonicalize each official test pair by sorting its two IDs. Rank by SHA256('566:'+pair_id), ascending. Choose orientation from low bit of first eight digest hex digits.
sampling.roles: First two source-pair groups are smoke-only; next twenty are evaluation-only.
sampling.grouping: Keep both source IDs and all derivatives in one role; verify source-video disjointness.
sampling.identity_limit: Official source-video groups do not prove person-identity disjointness. Record known identities, check overlap, and do not claim identity separation without evidence.
sampling.exclusions: Decode/availability failures logged before inference; no replacement based on model performance. Any changed membership requires a reviewed version.
sampling.transfer_split: No deepfake training, validation, threshold fitting, calibration fitting, or prompt tuning on evaluation media.
sampling.media_budget: Before retrieval, estimate bytes; no full archive fallback. Initial smoke cap proposed at 100 MiB, later evaluation cap 500 MiB, subject to team agreement.

frames.selection: On decoded target-original frame count N, choose floor(q*(N-1)); use corresponding frame indices for the fake. Fail the pair if synchronization/indices cannot be validated.
frames.output: Lossless RGB PNG; record decoder/version, source-video SHA256, frame index, timestamp, native dimensions, image SHA256 and decoded-pixel SHA256.
frames.primary_view: Full frame with the existing deterministic resize and 224 center crop; no new face detector or stochastic augmentation.
frames.limitation: Center crop can miss/suppress a manipulated face; review and record face visibility without choosing frames from detector scores. A face-crop study would be a separate agreed condition.
frames.future_conditions: JPEG60 and resize_112 only after clean transfer agreement, under separate identities.

checkpoints.selection_reason: Fixed operational pair, not selected from deepfake scores.
checkpoints.later_evaluation: All 48 saved k=7 heads: 8 GenImage holdouts x 3 dataset repeats x 2 modes, seed17. No winner selection on deepfake labels; no cross-head ensembling in primary analysis.
checkpoints.interpretation: The same deepfake evaluation is reused across heads. Their GenImage holdout names identify training provenance; they are not eight independent deepfake test datasets.
checkpoints.cnn_alignment: Use corresponding 48 corrected CNN k=7 checkpoints with the exact same image manifest if the CNN team agrees.
checks: Match config to TRAINING_COMPLETE.json protocol hash.
Match best_head.pt SHA256 to completion marker.
Confirm corrected dataset fingerprint and smoke_test=false.
Record backbone weight SHA256 and package/source versions.

vit_inference.features: L2-normalize float image embeddings before saved nn.Linear(feature_dim,1).
vit_inference.runtime: Encoder and head eval(), requires_grad=False, torch.inference_mode(); no optimizer or training entry point.
vit_inference.loading: Load existing backbone file explicitly by local path; fail if missing, no automatic clip.load model-name download.
vit_inference.warning: Existing run_vit_master.py --smoke-test exercises training and must not be used for this milestone.
vit_inference.outputs: Separate results/deepfake_transfer_smoke_v1; never write into accepted training or robustness folders.

acceptance.precheck: Reproduce saved clean predictions for at least two original benchmark images per class and each smoke head, joined by SHA256; record max probability difference (proposed tolerance 1e-5 in matching environment).
acceptance.smoke: 12 unique deepfake-domain frames x 2 heads = 24 scores, all finite in [0,1], exactly one score per image/head; validated labels and joins; same probabilities within 1e-6 across two passes in the same environment.
acceptance.immutable: Checkpoint and backbone SHA256 unchanged before/after; no gradient state, optimizer state or training artifact created.
acceptance.record: Manifest/policy/code/checkpoint/backbone hashes; device, versions, timing, raw predictions and explicit pass/fail checks.
acceptance.interpretation: Smoke pass establishes inference plumbing only, with no accuracy target and no generalization conclusion.

metrics.primary_unit: Video, score = arithmetic mean of its three frame prob_fake values.
metrics.secondary: Frame-level same metrics, explicitly correlated within video.
metrics.comparisons: Pair baseline vs augmented and CNN vs ViT by image_id and source group; average per-head metrics over repeats then training-provenance holdouts; also retain per-head results.
metrics.uncertainty: If intervals are reported, paired cluster bootstrap over 20 source-pair groups, reusing each bootstrap draw across all models/heads (seed566, 2000 draws). State small sample and unresolved identity overlap; never treat heads x frames as independent data.
metrics.planned_counts: 120 frame scores and 40 video scores per head; 5760 frame scores and 1920 video scores for 48 ViT heads.
metrics.k_question: k=7 transfer alone does not test whether generator diversity improves deepfake transfer. Extending to k=1/2/4 is a separately agreed follow-up.

multimodal.status: Await owner, exact available model/version, fixed prompt/parser and cost limit approval.
multimodal.inputs: Same 120 canonical PNG files, one image per request, neutral names; no dataset, label, source-path or pair context in prompts.
multimodal.prompt_draft: Does this image contain an AI-generated or digitally replaced face? Return JSON with label REAL or FAKE. Judge visible content only.
multimodal.scoring: Fixed parsing; retain raw response and invalid/refused/timeout states. Report coverage and all-sample accuracy with invalid counted incorrect, plus valid-only metrics. If only labels exist, do not report AUROC.
multimodal.video_rule: Majority vote of three valid frame labels; any missing/invalid response makes the video invalid in the primary all-sample report.
multimodal.consistency: Prompts, retries and aggregation frozen before evaluation; no tuning after seeing labels.
multimodal.budget: Zero API calls authorized/launched in this planning milestone; freeze a dollar/request cap before execution.
